title: Maker Request 1
description: Something the app cannot do, asked for by a child or a grown-up in a talk with the tutor and sent on their tap (Send this to the maker). Forwarded to the Mayor. The learner is only an id: a child's name never goes on chain.

kind.description: tutor-ask is an ask the tutor offered to pass on; the others are an expected ask picked on Requests (game, subject, look, setting, other).

text.description: What was asked, in the person's words.

summary.description: The tutor's one-line summary of the ask, or the start of the words.

reference.description: The talk it was filed from.

who.description: Who asked: a learner's id on the phone, or grown-up.

app_version.description: The SpellForge build it was sent from.
